orders.thesis: Amazon's AWS capex ramp feeds a long-term Amazon supply deal with Generac ($2.4B deliveries 2027-28) and a ~$4.5B data center backlog reported Oct 28. Stock sold off ~15% from its October high and reversed intraday on good news, while data-center-power peers (VRT, NVT, ETN) rallied 3-14% on the Vertiv read-through. Amazon reports after the close Oct 29, a catalyst for capex commentary.
